name: fair family
text: fair family, folk is a translation of tylwyth teg. The phrase names the Welsh fairies. Tylwyth teg is the usual Welsh term.

attributes.attribute: English translation of the Welsh tylwyth teg

okr.objective: Record fair family as the English translation of the Welsh tylwyth teg.
key_results: States the Welsh source term tylwyth teg.
Marks fair family as the standard Welsh label for fairies.
